findings.where: #global-ui controls: four .side-button (right edge, 65x65 at x 1345), .dialog-button, ten .emoji-bg cells, .continue-button (174x58 centred)
findings.evidence: dom-1440.json lists 17 visible control-shaped elements, all plain <div> with no role, no accessible name, no text and not interactive; focus.json has 0 stops. Nothing on the page can be reached by Tab.
findings.after: <button type="button" class="continue-button">Continue</button>; side buttons as <button aria-label="[DATA NEEDED: what each does, e.g. Map, Sound]">; emoji cells as a radiogroup or buttons with aria-label per emoji.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.1.1 Keyboard and 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value: controls must be focusable and expose a name and role.

findings.evidence: The whole experience is a WebGL canvas with no text alternative: body text is empty (dom bodyText ''), no h1, no main (sweep), and the canvas carries no aria-label or fallback content.
